name: @luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart
description: 给 DSH 桌面版加一键重启：只结束 Electron 主进程，宿主自己优雅退出、会话照常落盘；有任务在跑时先问你，插件在装时硬拦；重启完告诉你停机多久、新实例起来没有。六个入口可逐个关闭，另带登录数据体检、遗留临时文件预览、隐藏账号菜单反馈项。界面跟随应用语言（中/英）。 One-click restart for DSH Desktop: ends only the Electron main process so the host exits gracefully and sessions flush; asks first when work is running, hard-blocks while plugins install, then reports the downtime and whether the new instance came up. Six independently toggleable entry points, plus a sign-in data health check, leftover temp-file preview and a hide-feedback switch. UI follows the app language (zh/en).
